findings.what: SIGNED_FIELDS still omits gate-read correlation/timestamp fields: sprint_id and started_at, while gauntlet-verify uses sprint_id for sprint correlation and completed_at ?? started_at for liveness timing.
findings.why: A signed record can be edited from sprint_id SP-A to SP-B without invalidating verifyRecord, and verifyGauntlet({sprintId:'SP-B', requireSignature:true}) returns ok:true/ran. A signed record with no completed_at can also have started_at added after signing and still verify/green. This leaves a no-secret false-green path in the release liveness gate despite requireSignature:true.

parsed.summary: R2 fixes for ok/fallback/verdict signing, legacy-field fallback removal, panel requireSignature live wiring, and strict top_level_human_default validation are substantially present, and targeted tests passed. Verdict remains fail because the signature field set is still incomplete for gauntlet decision fields, so the core signed-record replay/mutation class is not fully closed.
